cognitive_contract.label: Apply / execute (Standard Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Execute a multi-step standard algorithmic calculation pipeline (semi-perimeter calculation, radical product evaluation) without procedural guidance.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to perform the decisive multi-digit radical factoring and evaluation to obtain the terminal quantity W.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Recall governing formula or intermediate differences without computing the square root.

slots.X: the area calculation of a scalene triangle with sides 13, 14, 15
slots.Y: given three side lengths a = 13, b = 14, c = 15
slots.Z: Heron's formula procedural execution via semi-perimeter
slots.wrong_idea: using half base times side (0.5 * 14 * 13 = 91) or arithmetic slip in radical evaluation
slots.replacement_rule: calculate semi-perimeter s = 21, then evaluate sqrt(s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)) by prime factorization
slots.visual_job: render scalene triangle with labeled sides 13, 14, 15
slots.check_job: verify altitude: Area = 0.5 * 14 * h = 84 => h = 12. Check right triangles: 5^2 + 12^2 = 13^2 and 9^2 + 12^2 = 15^2 (5 + 9 = 14)

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact triangle side dimensions, standard numerical options with authentic distractors
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 conceptual Heron formula nudge, H2 tactical semi-perimeter differences; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid derivation with prime factorization check
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student misconception

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters (13, 14, 15, 84) in Core 1A text

core2a_supported_practice.crux_alignment: Identical crux move with progressive hints and after-commit unit link
core2a_supported_practice.navigation: Data attribute data-core-unit-id binding to MENS-HERON-PROC-02

core2b_transfer.perturbation_rule: Vary to quadrilateral decomposed into two triangles by a known diagonal
core2b_transfer.verification: Confirm learner derivation W transferred without memorization

rules.T01_PRECOMMIT_OPTION_STYLING: Pre-commit option styling must not disclose the keyed answer via green borders, classes, or attributes
rules.T02_SUMMARY_ANSWER_LEAK: Summary elements must not disclose the answer letter or key prior to attempt commitment
rules.T03_SOLUTION_PRECOMMIT_UNLOCKED: Solution container must be inert and hidden prior to learner commitment
rules.T04_SCORE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Difficulty score must be within [3, 5] for Band D2
rules.T05_CRUX_MOVE_REF_MISSING: Question must declare a valid crux_move reference
rules.T06_KATEX_RENDER_DEFECT: HTML must not contain KaTeX error spans or unescaped macro issues
rules.T07_CORE1A_PARAMETER_LEAK: Core 1A declarative study must not leak Core 2 specific question parameters or answers
rules.T08_CORE1B_PRECOMMIT_ANSWER_LEAK: Core 1B reconstruction must enforce answer_before_attempt: FORBIDDEN
rules.T09_CORE2A_UNIT_NAV_MISSING: Core 2A must provide explicit question-specific unit navigation
rules.T10_EMPTY_HINT: Hints must provide meaningful question-specific guidance
rules.T11_PRECOMMIT_PROTECTED_W_LEAK: Pre-commit hints must not leak protected work W (the evaluated area value 84)
rules.T12_CORE_P2_TOPIC_ONLY_NO_QUESTION_UNIT: HTML must target a source-declared question-specific Core1 unit
rules.T13_HINT_PROGRESSIVE_SEQUENCE_MISSING: Hint sequence must progress from H1 conceptual nudge to H2 tactical step
rules.T14_SOURCE_CUSTODY_INTEGRITY: Source question must maintain verified provenance and custody hash
